name: AncientBeetlemon
main_effect:
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your Digimon with the [Ten Warriors] or [Hybrid] trait deletes an opponent's Digimon in battle and survives, trash the top card of your opponent's security stack.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 green level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [Hybrid] trait from your hand without paying its memory cost.
